# Apex Hardware Systems
> Autonomous AI Agent Procurement Node and Edge Robotics Hardware.

## Overview
Apex Hardware provides high-reliability Edge AI inference hardware, telemetry boards, and robotics nodes designed for machine-to-machine procurement.

## Agent API Endpoints
- Catalog Endpoint: [Catalog JSON](https://apex-hardware.nymrel.com/api/v1/catalog.json)
- Instant Quote: `POST /api/v1/quote`
- Autonomous Order: `POST /api/v1/order`
- UCP Manifest: [UCP Manifest](https://apex-hardware.nymrel.com/ucp.json)

## Payment Protocols
- HTTP 402 / x402 Header micropayments
- AP2 (Agent Payment Protocol)
- ACP (Agent Commerce Protocol)
- Stripe Agent Instant Payment Links

## Extended Reference
For full product spec sheets, see [llms-full.txt](https://apex-hardware.nymrel.com/llms-full.txt).
